title: Playing Devil’s Advocate: Off-the-Shelf Persona Vectors Rival Targeted Steering for Sycophancy

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses on a forced-choice philosophical benchmark (philpapers2020) by calculating the difference in log probabilities between sycophantic and honest tokens (sycophancy logit) and measuring the binary rate of agreement with the user's stated opinion, with and without persona-based activation steering.
Measuring the baseline preference for the first option presented in forced-choice questions and mitigating it by evaluating with counterbalanced prompt orderings (e.g., swapping A/B choices).
